ASTER GED AG100 熱紅外放射率算的 Ninomiya 指標: Ninomiya indices derived from ASTER GED AG100 thermal emissivity
CTX／HRSC 地形（本隊用 HRSC+MOLA 200 m）: CTX/HRSC terrain; this study uses HRSC+MOLA 200 m
GLIMS 冰河輪廓（離最近冰河的距離）: GLIMS glacier outlines (distance to nearest glacier)
GMTED2010 230 m 坡度，0.1° 格內中位數: GMTED2010 230 m slope, median within each 0.1-degree cell
MCD 全球沙塵（Ls 每 30°）: MCD global dust at 30-degree Ls intervals
MCD 地表溫（Ls 每 15°）: MCD surface temperature at 15-degree Ls intervals
MCD12Q1 冰雪比例、GLIMS 冰河比例、年均 NDVI < 0 且年均溫: Maximum of MCD12Q1 ice/snow fraction, GLIMS glacier fraction, and annual NDVI < 0 with annual mean LST < 0 C
TES 夜間熱慣量 2007 的全球分位數: Global percentile of TES nighttime thermal inertia (2007)
USGS SIM3292 全球地質圖＋文獻覆寫: USGS SIM3292 global geologic map with literature overrides
≤-2 滿分，≥2 為 0: Full score at <= -2 C; zero at >= 2 C
≤20 滿分，≥300 為 0: Full score at <= 20 km; zero at >= 300 km
≤5 滿分，≥15 為 0: Full score at <= 5 degrees; zero at >= 15 degrees
南極沒有 NDVI，當作沒有植被: Antarctic NDVI is unavailable; the source method treats Antarctica as unvegetated
南緯 60° 以南沒有這個資料（南極是極地沙漠、沒有植被），補 1；其他地方缺資: South of 60 S, this unavailable variable is assigned similarity 1 by the source polar-desert assumption; elsewhere missing data prevent scoring
火星熱慣量 100→150 = 火星第 21→29 百分位: Mars TI 100-150 corresponds to Mars percentiles 21-29; compared against Earth ATI percentile
表觀熱慣量 ATI（MODIS）的全球百分位: Global percentile of apparent thermal inertia ATI (MODIS)
SkyFall design reference landing site AP: SkyFall design reference landing site AP-105, 43.3295N 198.5228E, quoted in the team Mars plan citing the SkyFall engineering constraints package. The 50 km study radius covers the 100 x 25 km landing ellipse. The original reference document is pending.
